correctness.rationale: For connected degree-seven one-pole characteristic-three AS cover, Riemann–Hurwitz yields g=6 and the single-branch Deuring–Shafarevich formula yields 3-rank zero. Pole valuations ord∞(x)=-3, ord∞(y)=-7, ord∞(dx)=10 prove the six displayed differentials form a basis. Using inverse-Frobenius-semilinear Cartier and y=y³-f, C(x²dx)=dx, C(ydx)=-c^(1/3)dx-a^(1/3)x dx, and C(x y dx)=-d^(1/3)dx-b^(1/3)x dx-x²dx. Thus rank C is 3 iff a !=0, otherwise 2; rank C²=1 and C³=0 uniformly. Under x->ux+v the x5 coefficient cannot be created from x7 because binom(7,2)=21 vanishes mod3; eliminating powers divisible by 3 does not create x5. The hyperplane condition is well-defined in the marked normalization.
